deploy-bot: Canary rolled to prod-apac (canary 8%): inference-api v3.12.0. Starting post-deploy synths: prefills, embed-echo, qa-eval-set. run=sniff-3241598765
erin: quick flag from QA synth: automatic eval set shows a quality delta — ~3.2% increase in hallucination score on the standard prompts at ~2m after canary. Not a latency/5xx issue but output quality.
max: can you paste the failure examples? is this model variant change or tokenizer update?
dev-qa: sample pair: prompt="Summarize recent outage" expected contains incident facts; model returned invented error codes and timestamps. Example: "Error ZX-12 encountered at 03:00" (not in logs). This pattern appears across 7 prompts.
sree: interesting — model code didn't change major weights, but tokenizer mapping bump landed in this artefact (tokenizer v2.1). Could cause subtoken alignment shifts -> hallucination.
erin: threshold in release policy is 1% quality delta. We're at 3.2%. Recommend hold and rollback pin to v3.11.8 for apac until we triage.
ops-bot: auto-telemetry: eval.quality.delta=3.2, affected-route=chat-summarize, canary_shard=apac-b. Auto-fallback not applicable for quality deltas.
julia: hold on rollout. Instead of full rollback, can we pin chat-summarize route to fallback variant that uses tokenizer v2.0 while we build a patched artefact? Router supports per-route variant override.
max: that would limit blast and avoid global rollback. Do we have a tested fallback variant with v2.0?
sree: yes — variant tag "tok-stable" exists for the older tokenizer. We need to ensure routing policy can target it without losing other features. Small risk of minor perf delta.
erin: proceed with per-route pin for chat-summarize in apac to tok-stable for 60m while we hotfix tokenizer mapping. Also open RD-3502 for root cause.
ops-bot: Executing route pin: `rdctl route-pin --service inference-api --route chat-summarize --region prod-apac --to-tag tok-stable --duration 60m --note "qa-eval-quality-diff"`
deploy-bot: Route pin applied. Canary rollout paused. Monitoring synthetic evals.
dev-qa: re-running QA eval on pinned route now. Preliminary: quality delta reduced to 0.2% on pinned traffic samples. Good.
ejulia: please also add a preflight check to CI that runs the canonical QA eval set after tokenizer build step to avoid shipping tokenizer-only regressions.
max: agreed. follow-ups: 1) add tokenizer cross-check in artifact builder 2) add QA-eval gating at preflight 3) update release notes with brief note about pinned route and follow-up fix.
sree: I'll prepare patched tokenizer mapping and run full regression in staging. will post PR and staging evals to RD-3502.
erin: if patched staging passes QA-eval we can resume canary from 8% -> 25% over 15m.
ops-bot: Closing loop: route pin applied, canary paused, issue RD-3502 created.
